module.Title: Warn Before Motor Start
module.Teaching: range() can count downward by using a negative step. The stop value is still excluded.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which argument makes the countdown decrease?
module.PredictionExplanation: The third range argument is the step, and -1 subtracts one each time.
module.DebugPrompt: A positive step cannot move from 5 toward the lower stop value.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the five-second startup countdown. Use these exact identifiers: print, range, seconds. Use these exact values: 0, 1, 5, "Motor starting".
module.TransferPrompt: Create a three-second fan-start countdown. Use these exact identifiers: print, range, seconds. Use these exact values: 0, 1, 3, "Fan starting".
module.PreviewMessage: The system now gives operators a startup warning.
